question: Does the Ti40Zr10Cu36Pd14 bulk metallic glass (BMG) surface lower human gingival fibroblast metabolic activity relative to Ti6Al4V at 24 and 48 h, and can the alamarBlue signal of Zenodo 8342247 say so?
restated_question: On one public alamarBlue export (HGF on BMG vs Ti6Al4V specimens, 24 and 48 h), which readings can be compared with which prediction, and what would be needed to tell cytotoxicity, equality, more activity and interference apart.

objectives.statement: Judge whether the BMG surface is cytocompatible for HGF relative to Ti6Al4V (taken from the dataset's stated purpose; no researcher stated it here).

confirmed_conditions: HGF (PromoCell) seeded at 2000 cells per 3 mm specimen, 4 h adhesion, then 450 ul medium (paper sec2.6.2)
alamarBlue read after 24 h and 48 h culture; Ex 530 / Em 590, gain 80 (export header)
open_conditions: What the two 'AB' wells contain (neither the record nor the paper defines them)
Whether the specimen was in the well that was read, or the dye was transferred
Whether wells are independent specimens; the paper says triplicate, the export has 4 and 5 wells
Well positions of the typed values; the 48 h grid puts AB at C7-C8, the plate-area line says H8-H9
assumptions: the Ti6Al4V wells read above the reagent-only background at the same read
the BMG specimen does not change alamarBlue fluorescence without cells

sub_questions.question: Does the BMG surface change HGF alamarBlue signal relative to Ti6Al4V, and why?

hypotheses.statement: The BMG surface lowers HGF metabolic activity or number relative to Ti6Al4V.
BMG and Ti6Al4V support equal HGF metabolic activity.
The BMG surface supports more HGF metabolic activity (more cells or more activity per cell).
The BMG specimen raises the alamarBlue reading without cells (assay interference).

evidence_links.reading: The authors report comparable metabolism at 24/48 h, a slight non-significant increase for BMG at 48 h (one-way ANOVA, Tukey).
Cells were seeded directly on 3 mm specimens; whether the specimen stayed in the read well is not stated.
Dye added directly onto specimens, 4 h in the dark, read on the Spark: a material contribution to the reading is not excluded by the procedure described.
'Performed in triplicate'; the export has 4 and 5 wells per group, so which unit was replicated is open.
